mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message (content, create_time, state, user_id, username, displayId, nickname, position) VALUES (#{content}, #{createTime}, #{state}, #{userId}, #{username}, #{displayId}, #{nickname}, #{position})
mapper.select: SELECT id, content, create_time as createTime, state, user_id as userId, username, displayId FROM message WHERE state = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT id, content, create_time, state, user_id, username, nickname, displayId, position FROM message ORDER BY state, create_time DESC
